entities.name: Second Sun
entities.description: Smaller of Amonkhet's two suns, controlled by Bolas's magic from 4500 to 4560 AR; also an early nickname of Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker dragon who fixed the Second Sun in the sky.

entities.name: Horn Monument
entities.description: Monument the Second Sun aligned with to announce Bolas's arrival.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: God whose arrows come from the Second Sun's light.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: God said to be born of the magic that created the Second Sun.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: Event during which Bolas invaded Amonkhet.

entities.name: Hour of Devastation
entities.description: Event after which the sun returned to its normal cycle.

events.summary: Bolas invades Amonkhet and magically fixes the Second Sun in the sky, casting perpetual daytime.
events.quote: he magically fixed the Second Sun in the sky

events.summary: The Second Sun aligns with the Horn Monument, announcing Bolas's arrival and the start of the hours.
events.quote: It eventually aligned with the Monument, announcing Bolas's arrival and the start of the hours .

events.summary: After the Hour of Devastation the sun returns to its normal cycle and night returns.
events.quote: After the Hour of Devastation, the sun returned to its normal cycle, returning night to the plane.

relations.quote: was controlled by Bolas's magic between 4500 and 4560 AR
